issues.description: The template's detect_errors function signature returns list[int] whereas the problem statement and the solution expect/return a numpy ndarray of dtype int8. The template's docstring further claims it returns an npt.NDArray[np.int8], creating an internal contradiction in the template and a cross-artifact mismatch with the solution and spec. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and may cause type/shape errors when students write code that interfaces with tests or other functions (which expect numpy arrays).
issues.suggested_fix:
Make the template's detect_errors signature and docstring consistent with the problem statement and solution. Change the return annotation to npt.NDArray[np.int8] (and adjust any docstring text accordingly), e.g.:

def detect_errors(measurements: npt.NDArray[np.int8], checks: npt.NDArray[np.int8]) -> npt.NDArray[np.int8]:
    """... Returns: npt.NDArray[np.int8] ... """

This aligns the template with the specification and the reference implementation and avoids student confusion.
